name: Sarkeras: Artifact of the Ancestors
storyline: War is inevitable, so the kingdom needs magical ore. Numerous expeditions have been sent to the ore mines to extract it. You are one of the king's best servants and are ordered to prepare a report on the situation in the mines. When you arrive, however, you discover that this will not be your only task...
summary:
War is imminent. Weapons made of hard ore are needed. Ambassadors are being sent to all the surrounding ore mines in the land to ascertain the ore reserves. You are one of those sent. But will your mission unfold as you expect? Find out...
Features:
- completely new world with an exciting story independent from the Gothic series
- approximately 20 quests and 15 NPCs
- about 2 - 3 hours of gameplay
- full german and polish voice over
- new music
- new interactive objects, items and monsters
- animals use objects for the first time
